t: In front of you is the Paternoster Square Column, a memorial column in the City of London. It was designed by Sir William Whitfield, a British architect and town planner who lived from 1920 to 2019. I don't have much more detail on the column itself, so I'll leave it there. It's worth a moment to walk around it and look at how it stands in the square, as the work of one of Britain's notable town planners.
